name: vinktar
description: Error tracking for your app that Claude can read. Already on Sentry? Keep the SDK and change the DSN. Starting fresh? Connect Vinktar on the Connectors tab and ask Claude: "Set up Vinktar for my app." It adds the SDK and checks that errors arrive. Then ask what broke, and Claude reads the stack trace, the release and what the user did before. Product analytics on the same users, free up to 50,000 errors a month.
